title: 👑 Elite Challenge ⭐⭐⭐⭐: Master of Market Street

questions.prompt: Three of these sentences are correct. Which one is NOT correct?

options.text: The bike costs three hundred dinars.
The bike costs three hundreds dinars.
Three hundred people were at the market.
Hundreds of people were at the market.

questions.explanation: The faulty sentence is The bike costs three hundreds dinars: after a number, hundred never takes an -s. The word does take one in Hundreds of people were at the market, and that is the whole rule, because there no number stands in front of it.

questions.prompt: In which word do you hear the soft sound of garage, the buzz with no little d in front of it?

options.text: enjoy
jacket
jewellery
usually

questions.explanation: In usually the middle sound simply flows, exactly like the sound inside garage. In enjoy, jacket and jewellery the tongue hits the roof of the mouth first, so all three carry the harder sound of jeans, the one that begins with a tiny d.

questions.prompt: Your friend asks what you did last Saturday. Which answer is completely correct?

options.text: Last Saturday I go to the mall and I buy a tie.
Last Saturday I goed to the mall and I bought a tie.
Last Saturday I went to the mall and I bought a tie.
Last Saturday I went to the mall and I buyed a tie.

questions.explanation: Last Saturday is before now, and go and buy are both irregular, so both change shape: I went to the mall and I bought a tie. The answer with go and buy keeps the present after a past time word, while goed and buyed give the regular -ed to two verbs that refuse it.

questions.prompt: You are inside the mall, in front of the clothes shop. Which sentence is completely correct?

options.text: I like to buy the sweater on the corner of the shop.
I would like buy the sweater in the corner of the shop.
I would like to buy the sweater in the corner of the shop.
I would like to buy the sweater on the corner of the shop.

questions.explanation: Two rules meet here: a verb after would like always carries to, and a corner made by two walls inside a shop takes in. So the correct sentence is I would like to buy the sweater in the corner of the shop. The others drop the to, put the sweater out in the street with on, or replace the request by a taste with I like.

questions.prompt: Read: "Sonia went to the clothes shop last Sunday. She tried on a blazer. It was her size, but the blue colour was not good on her, so she did not buy it." Which sentence about the blazer is true?

options.text: It does not fit Sonia and it does not suit her.
It fits Sonia but it does not suit her.
It is too small for Sonia.
It suits Sonia but it does not fit her.

questions.explanation: The text says the blazer was her size, so it fits her, and that the colour was not good on her, so it does not suit her. Saying it is too small or that it does not fit her contradicts her size, and saying it suits her forgets the blue colour that sent her home without it.

questions.prompt: Read: "Karim had 500 dinars. At the music shop he bought a guitar for four hundred and twenty dinars." How many dinars has Karim now?
questions.explanation: Four hundred and twenty is written 420, so Karim has 500 - 420 = 80 dinars left. The answer 420 is the price of the guitar and not what is left, 920 adds the two numbers instead of taking one away, and 120 reads the price as 380.
